# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

- (unverified until RESULT, cand_0001) Biggest single root cause seen in traces: the agent reads inputs from the non-data_only workbook, gets '=...' strings, and then loops re-sending the same block until MAX_TURNS. The fix is in the template skeleton code (two copies), not in prose. Sibling-run evidence: growing the champion prompt with extra rules regressed val by 0.025-0.1 each time.

## Evidence-surfacing vs rule-adding (cand_0002, unverified until RESULT)
- Promising but not yet confirmed: most remaining failures are "the answer was in the workbook but never printed". Examples: a 'desired result' sheet (409-45), pre-filled example rows beyond the first 5 (547-43), a cached serial in the target revealing the source column (45896), a '#DIV/0!' totals row inside the target (183-8). cand_0002 adds prints and scans for these instead of new rules.
